title: duplicate_slide
description: Duplicate a slide (its shapes, images, charts, notes); the copy goes right after it unless a position is given.

slide_id.description: The slide: its number in the deck (1 = first, as the deck map and the person say it) or its ID.

position.description: Only when the person says where the copy goes: its place counted from 0. Left out: right after the original.

after_slide_id.description: Only when the person says where the copy goes: right after this slide (its number or ID). Left out: right after the original.

before_slide_id.description: Only when the person says where the copy goes: right before this slide (its number or ID).
